dialect: IETF interfaces, IP and LLDP (RFC 8343, RFC 8344, IEEE 802.1AB)
note: Lifted semantic model, interfaces side. Each concept carries its lexical label, synonyms, a shallow kind, a gloss, a canonical example, the reference entry the agent bound it to (ref), plus structural relations (edges to other concept ids in this model) and concrete instances. A live side volunteers its gloss/example; an inert side exposes only label, kind, relations, and instances. ref of null marks an item with no public meaning.

concepts.label: device
concepts.gloss: one managed router: the system whose own interfaces and LLDP data are reported

concepts.label: interface
concepts.gloss: a physical Ethernet interface of a device, where exactly one cable ends; the device names it, so the name is unique only within that device

concepts.label: aggregate-interface
concepts.gloss: a logical interface that combines several physical interfaces of the same device so that they act as one
concepts.example: ae3 on ywg-cr-00, over et-0/0/1 and et-0/0/2

concepts.label: lower-layer-if
concepts.gloss: the layering reference that says which physical interfaces sit underneath an aggregate interface
concepts.example: ae3 has lower layers et-0/0/1 and et-0/0/2

concepts.label: remote-systems-data
concepts.gloss: what a physical interface has learned by LLDP about the far end of its cable: the neighbouring system and the neighbouring port
concepts.example: et-0/0/1 on ywg-cr-00 sees port et-0/0/2 of yxe-cr-03

concepts.label: speed
concepts.gloss: the nominal bandwidth of an interface, in bits per second

concepts.label: phys-address
concepts.gloss: the address of a physical interface at the layer below the network layer: its hardware (MAC) address

concepts.label: ipv4 address
concepts.gloss: an IPv4 address configured on an interface

concepts.label: router-id
concepts.gloss: the routing identifier of a device

concepts.label: name
concepts.gloss: the name the device itself gives an interface; unique only within that device, so the same name recurs on other devices

concepts.label: if-index
concepts.gloss: a device-local integer index of an interface; arbitrary, and unique only within that device
